verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official TypeScript SDK (npm install @capacities/api), and its new developer portal lists SDKs and TypeScript SDK samples alongside the OpenAPI spec. The evidence shows only one SDK language, with thin docs and no hands-on use. missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, in-depth SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the Capacities TypeScript SDK: npm install @capacities/api
Interactive OpenAPI specification with every endpoint, schema, rate limit, and TypeScript SDK sample
